title: MONARK forbidden keys — fleet invariant
description: MONARK fleet invariant (ADR-M001 Decision 7, extended by ADR-M008 D5). Union of THREE disciplines: Shogen 03 §0 (temoignage_canonique.rs L15-19: no truth field, no confidence score, no 'validated') + Grok hac-cp.ts:77 (p_correct, confidence, hallucination_score, hallucination) + Narabi/AttestedFlow (peg_score, p_depeg, nav: a flow is measured under coverage, never scored). NONE of these keys may appear at ANY level of a serialized contract. NOTE: price/mid are NOT banned globally (legitimate on the attest envelope); they are banned on AttestedFlow by its closed schema alone. Primary enforcement = closed schemas (additionalProperties:false); this list = defense in depth, applied RECURSIVELY.
